purpose: Few-shot re-evaluation after deleting residual flows, paired with EXP94 on the same test rows.
approval: User request 2026-11-06: run the few-shot evaluation on the data with residual flows deleted.
residual_rule: A flow is residual when the previous flow on the same 5-tuple ended by rst or fin_handshake, the gap is 0 to 2 s, packets <= 2, payload is 0 and the first packet has no SYN.
inherited: Flow IDs, labels, split of each flow, seeds 43 to 47, budgets 2 to 50, regimes, XGB and TabPFN settings and TabPFN checkpoint come from protocol_snapshot.json of the base run. Tokens, embeddings and statistics of the remaining flows are reused unchanged.
pca: PCA 64 is refit on the train rows that remain, including unresolved rows, with the same seed. The statistics view has no projection.
scoring: One scoring only: the test rows that remain after deletion. The EXP94 baseline is recomputed from its saved predictions on exactly these rows.
sampling_note: Few-shot pools lose the residual rows, so selected rows can differ from EXP94 at the same seed. The comparison is paired by seed, budget, method and view.
